preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore authoritative FPS recovery and Alpha checkpoint input, retain hardware-ready three-cycle performance evidence, and complete the accessible physical-G product-shell flow while preserving clean boot and all Tester-preserved assets and controls.

diagnosis.root_cause: The active failures form three independent ownership families. F6 bypasses authoritative mission recovery and invokes a player-local reset that restores the AK-74M default; unavailable Alpha checkpoint progression then blocks checkpoint-local mouse-look proof. Performance qualification lacks retained target-resolution evidence across three complete lifecycle cycles. Product-shell accessibility has physical-G and partial reflow work, but complete 200% Settings reachability and persisted 100% restoration remain unqualified.

stop_conditions: Do not replace or surgically modify the preserved map, weapon/viewmodel, enemy-animation, menu, typography, or HUD packages.
Do not accept tester setup actions, checkpoint relocation, teleportation, state injection, or process restart as ordinary-route, navigation, milestone, or lifecycle acceptance.
Do not claim performance qualification from editor, headless, partial-cycle, or synthetic samples; the hardware-backed verdict remains Host/Tester-owned.
Do not reduce requested UI scale, hide critical content, or move controls outside the 5% safe area to make 200% fit.

Stop if changes introduce boot/import failure, candidate-script errors, duplicate recovery commits, added countdown time, invalid enemy occupancy, conflicting R/F6 bindings, or release-accessible tester actions.
Do not expand into deferred bomb-finale, combat-feedback, audio/VFX, animation-retargeting, environment-density, or broad polish work.

strategy.rationale: Keep the host-selected FPS combat, performance stability, and product-shell UI families separate. Repair F6 through direct versioned instance restoration rather than transform tuning, complete performance through a bounded non-authoritative observer rather than gameplay changes, and repair Settings through semantic reflow rather than fixed-coordinate accommodation. Add deterministic non-release setup receipts only where they accelerate branch-local inspection after one ordinary route smoke.

Verify physical G skip, R-only reload, F6-only reset, and absence of release-bound tester actions.

Host/Tester: execute three complete mission/restart/replay cycles at hardware-backed 1920x1080, retain every raw sample page and aggregate, then inspect final runtime/editor errors.

Capture ordinary Alpha combat and checkpoint-restored gameplay; verify grounded separated enemies, readable objective/countdown hierarchy, borderless HUD, and unobstructed reticle/viewmodel.
For tester-assisted late branches, pair each distinct state screenshot with its resolved setup receipt and runtime state; do not use branch-local frames as route or terminal acceptance.
